text:
Type: soft fabric wall clock
Use: telling time on a wall; children's room, playroom, bedroom
Style: contemporary, modern, retro
Materials: padded black fabric face, yellow fabric piping and hanging loop, yellow center, colored plastic hands
Colors: black, sunny yellow, turquoise, navy blue, orange
Shape: large flat round disc like a vinyl record, stitched black hour marks, bright yellow center, hangs from a fabric loop, soft and light
Feel: playful, bold, cheerful, fun
Goes with: bright primary colors, white walls, light wood; colorful children's rooms and playrooms

product.name: PLADDRA
product.description: The clock has a blackboard face, so you can write or draw pictures of activities next to the hours to help your child learn about time.
